lines.spoken: Its coordinator hands each piece of work to a thread.
A thread keeps its context, so a follow-up goes back to the thread that already knows the work.
Claude Code, Codex and other agents work in parallel, on your own machines.
When one agent hits a usage limit, the same thread continues on another.
Agents can even use your own Chrome, with the SpecWithCode Browser extension.
SpecWithCode is a free download for macOS, Windows and Linux.
At spec-weave dot com slash code.
